title: FinetuneJob
description: The invoke payload for the KFT `finetune` capability (specs/fine-tuning.md §3, KFT 0.4.0). The machine-readable twin of the job manifest. Two intakes — a base model and a dataset — each a reference plus, optionally, the document that describes it in its own standard's terms; the shape follows Kubeflow TrainJob's initializer.{model,dataset}.storageUri precedent (§3.2). Data is referenced by KINP/KGP/KMI id, never inlined, and no descriptor is ever an admission input. The cross-schema $refs below resolve against schemas/provenance.schema.json (shared $defs) and schemas/dataset-jsonl-header.schema.json (the training-record header) in this directory. A golden positive example lives at schemas/fixtures/finetune-job.json; the validators + conformance suite that exercise this schema live downstream in a runtime commons per ADR-0001 (koine = contracts), NOT in koine.

kinpId.description: A KINP CURIE — namespace:kind:local (e.g. orchestrator:activity:ft-run/9f2a, refkb:model:qwen2.5-3b-instruct, kgp:pack:sha256-7b1e…, analyzer:asset:blake3-a1b2…).

kft_version.description: The KFT spec version this job was authored against (semver). A finetuned model pins the kft_version it was trained under (KFT §11).

job.description: The KINP PROV activity id for this run — the reproducibility anchor (KFT §5.2, FT-C).

base_model.description: Intake 1 — the base-model KINP `model` entity, the counterpart of Kubeflow TrainJob's initializer.model.storageUri (KFT §3.2). External (Hub) bases are minted entities carrying an external anchor to their Hub coordinate — never a raw hf:… string (KFT §5.1, FT-G).

base_model_descriptor.description: KMI asset ids of the base model's published description — its Hugging Face model card (carrying base_model / base_model_relation, KFT §5.1.1) and/or its KitOps/ModelPack Kitfile (KFT §5.3.1), adopted by reference; KFT restates neither. The model-side twin of dataset.descriptor. Optional and descriptive: the §4.2 egress gate, §4.3 license/trust lineage, and §7 estimate MUST NOT read it, and a base-model coordinate, license, or egress class MUST NOT be derived from it — on disagreement the KINP entity wins (KFT §3.2).

modality.description: KFT §3.1 modality vocabulary. Registered in koine registry/. modality × method compatibility is validated at admission (FT-F).

method.description: Training method. Not independent of modality — an incompatible combo (e.g. dpo × text-to-image) is rejected at admission (KFT §3.1, FT-F).

dataset.description: Intake 2 — training data by reference only (KFT §4.1), the counterpart of Kubeflow TrainJob's initializer.dataset.storageUri, split three ways because a koine corpus is knowledge, media, or training records (KFT §3.2). At least one of knowledge/media/records MUST be non-empty.

media.description: KMI asset ids (multimodal image/video/audio data), fetched lazily via KCB fetch:asset.

records.description: KMI asset ids of the training-record JSONL file(s) — a producing application's training exhaust, and the FT-I per-sample join surface. Each carries media type application/vnd.koine.dataset+jsonl (registry/media-types.tsv) and opens with a dataset-jsonl-header (KFT §4.1, FT-M).

descriptor.description: KMI asset ids of MLCommons Croissant v1.1 dataset descriptions (application/ld+json), adopted by reference — KFT describes no dataset itself (KFT §4.1.1). Not positional: one descriptor may cover any subset of knowledge/media/records. Optional and descriptive: the §4.2 egress gate, §4.3 license/trust lineage, and §7 estimate MUST NOT read it; on disagreement the dataset-jsonl-header wins.

header.description: The dataset-jsonl-header(s) copied inline — carries tier + license + egress + recordCount + provenance so the §4.2 gate and §7 estimate run before any fetch. An array, positionally one per records[] entry (FT-O); a bare object is the degenerate one-file form. Verified against the file's actual first record on fetch; a disagreement rejects the job (KFT §4.1).

hyperparams.description: Method-specific hyperparameters (epochs, lr, max_seq_len, lora{r,alpha,dropout,target_modules}, …). Permissive — engine adapters own the detail (KFT §9). With `method`, this is KFT's deliberate divergence from TrainJob, which passes adaptation through spec.trainer.args (KFT §3.2).

export.description: Requested output variants, e.g. gguf:Q4_K_M, safetensors-adapter, onnx. Each becomes a KMI variant_of/derived_from asset (KFT §5.3).

compute.description: Placement request. The effective egress is verified against {data ∪ base} at admission and a local-only run is pinned to local compute (KFT §4.2, FT-B).

class.description: Requested compute class (e.g. local-mps, single-gpu-a100-80gb) — a class, not a pod resource shape (contrast TrainJob's spec.trainer.resourcesPerNode; KFT §3.2). A cross-boundary class is rejected for a local-only-effective run (KFT §4.2).

egress.description: derived = compute from data ∪ base (recommended); explicit values are still verified and rejected on violation (KFT §4.2, KGP §7.2).

eval.description: KCS conformance-scenario ids used as eval/reward (KFT §6.1). A local-only model is evaluated in-tier (FT-D).

seed.description: Training seed — part of the run's reproducibility anchor (KFT §5.2, FT-C).

config_hash.description: sha256- of the fully-resolved engine config — the other half of the run reproducibility anchor (KFT §5.2, FT-C).

signing.description: Shared signing shape (KCB §5 / KGP §9.3) so the run is cryptographically attributable (KFT §7).
